source.origin: logikbench upstream RX (ofdm_rx.v + fft.v concatenated) at N=32/CP=8; the only edits are two RTLScout-marked one-line localparam corrections (LAT 70->37 measured, LOG2N 6->$clog2(N)) for values hardcoded to N=64 upstream; the same corrections are applied to the recast design
source.design: upstream NATIVE interface: the noisy symbol streamed in as 40 in_valid beats (I/Q parallel, mod held), demapped payload returned on one out_valid beat; native schedule metered per case (reset release -> out_valid), no memory port
source.oracle: same 21 jobs and goldens as ofdm32_demod_1r1w (vectors.dat byte-identical, stride 93); TB checks the 12 golden out_bits words per case
source.purpose: the upstream's own ARP under the study flow, for the upstream comparison -- a measurement vehicle, not an agent-optimization benchmark
